title: IssueBench: Millions of Realistic Prompts for Measuring Issue Bias in LLM Writing Assistance

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to generate writing assistance text about 212 political and societal issues using neutral, positive, and negative framings, and classifying the expressed stances on a 5-point pro/con scale using an LLM-based stance classifier.
Comparing the aggregated pro-versus-con stance distribution of LLM responses on 20 specific political issues against real-world polling data from self-identified US Democrat and Republican voters.
